rules.source_statement: The horoscope centre reads 'Die Mercurij / 16 Julij 1645 / 7:22 A.M. / hor: ♄' in its printed archaic forms. Die Mercurij identifies Wednesday, while ♄ represents a separate planetary hour.
preconditions: Single chart associated with this XLVI enquiry.
